headline: Earthquake near Suez shakes Cairo, Gaza and Jordan
caption:
A magnitude-5.5 earthquake struck 40km from the Suez Canal overnight, with tremors felt in Cairo, Gaza and Jordan. No casualties or canal disruption have been reported, but Egypt's Red Crescent has activated its emergency response plan.

headline: Drone Debris Kills Four, Including a Child, at Resort
caption:
Drone debris killed four people, including a child, in Gelendzhik, Russia, near a naval and oil-terminal complex. Officials said long-range drones carry errors of tens of metres; Ukraine has not commented and both sides deny targeting civilians.

headline: Cyclospora Kills Two in Michigan, a US First
caption:
Two people have died of cyclosporiasis in the United States, the first deaths ever recorded from the parasite. The CDC has confirmed over 11,000 cases nationwide, with Taylor Farms lettuce served at Taco Bell the suspected source.

headline: Telegram Vanished From Apple's App Store, Then Returned
caption:
Apple pulled Telegram from the App Store worldwide, blocking all new downloads before restoring it, with no explanation from either company. Installed copies kept working throughout.

headline: Drone Strike Kills Five Near Moscow
caption:
A Ukrainian long-range drone struck Novoselki near Moscow, killing five and wounding six in an industrial zone, governor Andrey Vorobyev said. Russian air defenses had engaged the drone before impact; Kyiv had not claimed the strike as of Tuesday morning.

headline: US Army Nearly Out of Precision Missiles
caption:
The US Army has nearly exhausted its precision missile stockpile after 5 months of war with Iran drained supplies built at only a few hundred units yearly. Patriot and missile-defense stocks are also strained, even as Trump insists supplies remain ample and Congress has authorized no war declaration.

headline: Drone Hunts Kherson Man Over Garlic
caption:
A drone operator in Kherson struck a 52-year-old vendor after he held up garlic to prove he was not filming. Ukraine's foreign minister called the killing a war crime, and a 2025 UN report already documented the pattern.
